answer.rationale: Do not match the competitor with broad promotional pricing: the recovered SMB experiment showed a 12% retention decline despite short-term revenue lift, creating poor sustainable-revenue economics. Instead, run a small guarded activation-messaging test for price-sensitive SMB accounts, building on evidence that in-product messaging improves week-one engagement and that faster onboarding improves time-to-value. Measure qualified revenue, first meaningful action, renewal-risk indicators, and retention before scaling. The competitor-driven churn increase creates uncertainty, so this should not be a broad rollout yet.
